0022600141.text: The Spurs (2-2) visit the Utah Jazz (1-3) for their fifth game of the season, and San Antonio arrives on a two-game winning streak after going 1-0 on the road so far, while sitting 7th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest. Utah is on a two-game losing streak, sits 13th in the West, and is 3 games back in the Northwest, with both teams having played four games so far. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, the Spurs won the 2025-26 series 2-1, and their last meeting was a 126-109 Spurs win in Salt Lake City on January 22, 2026. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Lauri Markkanen (wrist), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise).
